task_title: Implement operational execution-grant issuer and scoped TRACE client

criterion_1.statement: Read and implement complete immutable SA/SD. Verify fresh genuine Identity Platform user MFA, explicit operator UID allowlist, separate Ed25519 signer, actor/task/policy-bound single-use challenge, no client-selected policy substitutions. No fixture or ADC treated as real MFA.
criterion_1.evidence: Implemented IdentityPlatformTokenVerifier and ChallengeStore with complete cryptographic RSA-256 JWT validation, MFA second factor claim verification, operator UID allowlist enforcement, tenant checking, fail-closed revocation check, atomic challenge consumption, and policy invariance verification.

criterion_2.statement: Provide deployable isolated tooling issuer and TRACE-only client through existing qualified canonical show, verifier and grant submission. No new TaskStore writer or product route. Reject S5 and changed canonical bindings. Complete CI-wired cryptographic, malformed input, replay/race, expiry, redaction and isolated full-chain tests with terminal outputs.
criterion_2.evidence: Implemented ExecutionGrantIssuerService, request_execution_grant.py, systemd unit, and wired unittest test suites into scripts/run-acceptance.sh. Passed 45 comprehensive tests (36 in test_issuer.py, 9 in test_request_execution_grant.py) covering wrong signature, wrong issuer, audience, missing MFA, anonymous, custom provider, tenant verification, fail-closed revocation check, expired cert cache fail-closed, race condition, actor substitution, task substitution, policy tampering, immutable TRACE scope, empty trust rejection, symlink clobber prevention, and S5 pause.

criterion_3.statement: Publish exact source/checksum/test evidence, operations documentation, and isolation/reauthentication guides. Independent exact-head review, required CI, and PR merge are completed during handoff and integration. Source-only scope: does not mint live credentials, assert MFA or deploy hosted product workloads.
criterion_3.evidence: Documented full operational runbook in docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md. Manifest and exact source checksums updated for all 17 artifacts. Terminal test evidence recorded for 45/45 passing tests across issuer and CLI suites. No live credentials or synthetic live trust keys committed.
